newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH POLAR SAYS TO UP NET TO PLN 28 MLN BY 2000.
newsitem.headline: POLISH POLAR SAYS TO UP NET TO PLN 28 MLN BY 2000.

text.p: Polish household appliance maker Polar SA expects its annual net profit to rise to 28 million zlotys in 2000 from the six million zlotys seen for this year, the firm's financial director told a news conference on Friday.
Polar seeks a main market bourse listing in October.

"Our estimate, which provides that the firm's output will increase by 200,000 refrigerators and washing machines by the year 2000, also shows that the firm's net profit will amount to 28 million zlotys in 2000 ," Elzbieta Rytwinska-Kuzik said.
Polar's president Zbigniew Szczypinski, also present, said the company would produce 250,000 washing machines and 500,000 refrigerators this year.
The firm expects sales of 794 million zlotys in the year 2000 against 235 million zlotys in the first half of 1997 and an estimated 567 million zlotys for the whole of 1997.
